description: t.p reserves a slot, closes its sender while the permit is held, sleeps, and sends through the permit at 100. A Rust permit borrows its sender (SendPermit<'a>), so the body can drop the sender only after the permit is gone: the drop is projected there, when the send completes. t.r's first recv therefore gets 5 at 100 and only its second sees ASX_E_DISCONNECTED; the receiver is not told the channel is closed while a permit is outstanding.
